title: Impedance in the complex plane
caption: A 30 Ω resistor in series with an inductor of reactance 40 Ω has Z = 30 + 40i Ω. The resistance lies along the real axis and the reactance along the imaginary axis, so |Z| = √(30² + 40²) = 50 Ω and the phase is arctan(40/30) = 53°, voltage leading current.
alt: Phasor triangle: a 30 ohm arrow along the real axis, a 40 ohm arrow up from its tip, and the 50 ohm impedance at 53 degrees.
description: The resistance R = 30 Ω is drawn along the real (horizontal) axis.
The reactance X_L = 40 Ω is drawn from its tip along the imaginary (vertical) axis.
The impedance Z runs from the origin to the tip: |Z| = √(30² + 40²) = 50 Ω.
Its angle above the real axis is the phase: tan φ = 40/30, φ = 53°.

claims.name: the phase of Z is 53.1° from the resistance
